creative_direction: Create a badger head as a bold block-print collage, using large charcoal, warm gray, and cobalt shapes to describe the face. Three folded orange paper corners rise from the top like an irregular crown, integrated into the silhouette rather than placed as a separate royal prop. Turn the head slightly and keep the eyes small and steady, giving it a stoic quietly regal personality. Let paper fiber and uneven ink pressure appear within the broad shapes, but keep the muzzle and eye markings clearly readable. Use an unprinted cream background with no border. Center the compact head inside the safe circular avatar area, avoiding text, heraldic symbols, or a full body.
